title: Craftlings
description: Summon fantasy themed mobs and watch them clash in epic free for all battles, or set up full scale wars in custom arenas.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be918107d5efa406487bec53b13da20403a80c67.png)



![What is it?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ecc4214372484d60c740a7299789508907aea7ba.png) Craftlings is a sandbox battle mod that brings chaotic miniature warfare into Minecraft. Spawn fantasy themed Craftlings, and unleash epic battles from small battles to full scale arena wars. Whether you’re in creative mode designing arenas or in survival mode collecting items, Craftlings makes every world feel alive with tiny armies and strategic fun. And yes, it’s fully multiplayer compatible, so you and your friends can join the chaos together! You will see battles spawning around your survival world time to time so you can encounter them in the wild!

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01575ed4f336a7ae1e95990ce41fe34fc93bb106.png) - **Miniature Armies** – Summon Craftling mobs and watch them battle it out. - **Arena Battles** – Build battlegrounds and host tournaments. - **Survival Integration** – Acquire items naturally in survival mode. - **Shrink Mechanic** – Shrink down to Craftling size for a new perspective. - **Player Control** – Take direct control of your Craftlings with special items. - **Battle Management** – Purge fights, recall armies, or reset the battlefield anytime. - **Multiplayer Compatible** – Spawn mobs, build arenas, and battle with friends.

![Why Craftlings?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e43787bc397259dc9acca87be18f576b260dd1cc.png) Craftlings isn’t just about mobs fighting — it’s about **creativity, strategy, and hilarious chaos**. Host tournaments, recreate massive wars, or simply watch tiny armies tear each other apart. > **Bring fantasy warfare to life, one Craftling at a time.**

![Installation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/028f4aa88376c777b422fe1c106547389c7ecfa7.png) ### 🔹 Easiest Method (Recommended) 1. **Download the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)** - The app automatically manages mods, updates, and loaders for you. 2. Search for **Craftlings** in the app and click **Install**. - The correct version of NeoForged will be set up automatically. 3. Launch Minecraft and enjoy miniature battles! 🎉 --- ### 🔹 Manual Method 1. **Install [NeoForged](https://neoforged.net/)** - Download the recommended version of NeoForged for your Minecraft version. - Run the installer and set it up. 2. **Download Craftlings** - Get the latest `.jar` from the [Files] tab above. 3. **Place in Mods Folder** - Go to your Minecraft installation directory. - Open (or create) the `mods` folder. - Drop the `craftlings-.jar` file inside. 4. **Launch Minecraft** - Start Minecraft with the NeoForged profile. - Craftlings should appear in your mods list! --- **Tips:** - Make sure both **NeoForged** and **Craftlings** are for the **same Minecraft version** (e.g. `1.21.8`). - For multiplayer servers, install Craftlings on both the **client** and the **server**.
